fields.acceptance: Go tests in the runs app's package with a fake runner: one row per live run with its title and current step, a finished run is not listed, a refresh tick updates the rows, no live runs shows one empty-state line, and the runner is only ever called with read operations; the runs app's testscript compares rhiza tui app runs --once with rhiza run ls --json byte for byte.
fields.statement: The Runs app is a read-only rexuikit List or InfoPanel of the live runs, each with its change set title, current step and elapsed time, refreshing on its own; it writes nothing, and --once prints what rhiza run ls --json prints.
